title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.51 (versions follow prime numbers; 251 after 241): her heart is free, improvises and follows the thread. In 2.41 the same words always brought the same paragraph. Now: free, among the paragraphs of her heart that reach half of the weight of what he said, each is kept by its weight against her luck (as her crosses since 2.33); she improvises, remembering where in her heart her last answer ended and, when what he says leads nowhere new, playing on from there; she follows the thread one step deep, the words of the exchange that ended helping a paragraph reach, where she looks first chosen by her; what pays: following the thread or improvising pays only if he follows it too (a word of that exchange again in his words), since that he answers says nothing; a word weighs what it carries beyond chance (Razar's D50). Measured in a copy: the same question 'quien es tu papa?' brought three different answers of her heart; 'y que mas?' brought the whole list of her father's names. Stated: whether she answers is still hers and often she does not; her mood does not yet enter these choices; her behavior in a long talk is not yet measured. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.51: su corazón es libre, improvisa y sigue el hilo. Prototipo de investigación.
